note: Suriname: CARICOM members' citizens and the Vatican's enter free for 6 months (Montserrat 90 days); every other nationality enters without a visa for up to 90 days but must pay the entry fee online before arrival (taken as an ETA), except the 21 who must get an e-Visa (since 1 May 2023); Haitians are refused (taken as a visa). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Suriname
sources.said: Citizens from the following countries and territories may enter Suriname without a visa or paying an Entry Fee for the following period: 6 months Antigua and Barbuda Bahamas Barbados Belize Dominica Grenada Guyana Jamaica Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Lucia Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Trinidad and Tobago Vatican City 90 days Montserrat ... citizens of all other countries and territories may enter Suriname without a visa for visiting family / friends or for tourist purposes for up to 90 days. However, an entry fee of USD 50 or 50 euros is required to be paid online prior to arrival. ... Citizens of the following countries must obtain an e-Visa: Afghanistan Angola Bangladesh Cameroon Cuba Dominican Republic Egypt Eritrea Ghana India Kenya Nepal Nigeria Pakistan Somalia South Africa Sri Lanka Syria Tunisia Venezuela Zambia ... Entry and transit is refused to Haitian citizens
